meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Watch how you work and draft reusable skills from your repetitive research flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat the same research steps and want them saved as reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会查看 screenpipe 捕获的屏幕记录，找出你重复的研究工作流，与仓库已有技能比对，为没覆盖的部分起草新技能或组合方案，输出到待审阅目录。
howto.when: 当你明确提出要分析最近的工作并据此提议技能时触发。需本地运行 screenpipe 守护进程（默认 3030 端口），连不上它会拒绝运行。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads your screenpipe screen history, clusters repeated research workflows, compares them against existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes into ~/.autoskill/proposed for review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to analyze recent work (e.g. last 4 hours, day, or week) and propose skills. Needs a local screenpipe daemon on port 3030 and refuses to run if it cannot reach it.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and tell me what isn't covered yet
Draft new skills from my 2026-04-17 screen history
